criteria.text: `.mwnn/verification.json` exists at the repository root and parses as a version-1 profile (`version`, `criteria`, optional `focusedTests`) per `docs/independent-verification.md`

Every acceptance criterion on this card is mapped by exact checkbox text (without `- [ ]` / `- [x]`) to a non-empty `checks` array of allowed ids (`compile-tests`, `compile`, `focused-tests`, `tests`, `lint`, `diff`), or to `human: true` with empty `checks` when automation cannot prove it

Every acceptance criterion on cards that already failed with "Missing or invalid verification inputs" and still need independent verification (at least `card-mw89f8vw-1` and `card-mw8h6jsj-3`) is likewise mapped by exact text
Any `focusedTests` entries name only compiled `.test.js` files under `dist-test/test/`
With that profile in place, independent-verification input capture no longer fails with "Missing or invalid verification inputs" for a card whose criteria are fully mapped
Activation with no stored trial start and no license key does not write `mwnn-kanban-pro.trialStartedAt`
The first time a Pro feature opens with no stored trial start and no key, the 14-day trial starts and the feature opens
A stored trial start, active or expired, is never replaced: clearing a key or running a gated command does not start a new trial
Existing trial starts from 1.0.8 and 1.0.9 are honoured unchanged
Pro views still do not flash in unlicensed windows during startup
Unit tests under `node:test` cover each case above, and `npm run compile-tests`, `npm test`, and `npm run lint` pass
A command exits non-zero when the installed `@tempuskg/mwnn-kanban-pro` does not match the published tarball the lockfile resolves, and exits zero after a clean `npm ci`
The release instructions say to run it before tagging a release
It makes no network calls beyond the npm registry fetch that `npm ci` and `npm pack` already make, and needs no token beyond the existing `.npmrc`
`npm run compile-tests`, `npm test`, and `npm run lint` pass
Round-trip serialize/parse works; invalid values are ignored; date-only expands to `T00:00`
`setScheduledFor` updates or clears the field via store and panel message handling
